如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “那个，刚才谢谢你了。你渴不渴，我请你喝可乐。”
经过这么一番折腾，那个大美女总算是知道旁边坐着的这个小伙子，不是什么臭流氓，而是个热心人。这会儿为了感谢杨云帆刚才的出手相助，请对方喝可乐。
“道谢就不必了。不过，你请我喝可乐，还算你有点良心。”
杨云帆将可乐从那大美女手里接过来，“嗤”的一下拧开，不由咕噜咕噜喝了起来。
那大美女刚才出了一身汗，身上香水随着汗水蒸发起来，弄得整个位置上都是香味。她这一动，那香气萦绕，杨云帆这样一个血气方刚的少年闻到了，忍不住又多看了她几眼。
那如月羞涩的俏脸上，湿答答的粘着的几缕青丝，微微显得凌乱，却更添了三分妩媚。
“对了，你叫什么名字啊？看你的样子，不像是湘潭市的人。”
反正闲着无聊，火车还得走个七八个小时呢，杨云帆就随意跟旁边这大美女聊起天来。
那大美女红唇微微一抿，喝了一点白开水润喉，倒也不隐瞒，直接道：“是呢。我不是湘潭人，我是东海市的人，暑假的时候，在西边蜀山那里玩了一圈，这不快开学了嘛，所以我才坐火车回湘潭市来上学。时间过得真快呢，我还有好多地方没有去玩过呢。”
那大美女感慨了一下，暑假过得太快。
随即，她看向杨云帆，娇柔一笑，伸出小手，友好道：“我叫陆檀香，很高兴认识你。”
“檀香？这名字还挺有意思的。给你取名字的人，估计是个老中医吧。”杨云帆奇怪的看了眼前这个大美女一眼。
檀香，味辛，性温，无毒。入脾、胃、肺经。理气，和胃。可以治心腹疼痛，噎膈呕吐，胸膈不舒。《本草纲目》中说檀香可以治噎膈吐食。若是面生黑子，每夜以浆水洗拭令赤，磨汁涂之，可以痊愈。
“咦，你怎么知道的？”
听杨云帆这么一说，陆檀香倒是十分惊奇：“这名字就是我爷爷给我取的。他老人家还真是个老中医。都做了五十年中医了！能不是老中医吗？”
这话匣子一，你是哪个大学的？你是不是学医的啊？还有，你刚才说我不像湘潭人，那你是湘潭本地人咯？哈，到了湘潭，你可得好好招待我一下。”
杨云帆随意应付了几句，没敢答应下来。
虽然他老爸以前在湘潭市置办了不少的产业，但是他也不是湘潭市人，他的老家是东海市的。
而且，他很小的时候，就被老头子带去山上过苦日子了。
这次他给老头子来了一次狠的，藏在茅房后面的私房钱，都没有来得及拿，现在口袋里光溜溜的，自己吃饭都快成问题了……至于招待这个大美女，还是算了。

还有老头子说的，什么美女总裁未婚妻。
坑爹啊，老头子这家伙的嘴巴从来不能信。他要说是美女总裁未婚妻，肯定长得奇丑无比。
小爷我的命怎么那么苦啊！
杨云帆愁容满面，陆檀香倒是不知道原因。
她看杨云帆跟自己年纪相仿，背着个旅行包，脸庞晒得黝黑，而且身材结实，很有阳光气息，再加上刚才就随便捏了自己几下，反而治好了自己的痛经，对杨云帆反倒是起了好奇心。
“对了，小哥，你叫什么名字啊？”陆檀香眨巴着眼睛，一脸纯真模样，看着杨云帆。
“我叫杨云帆。”杨云帆言简意赅道。
“唔，杨云帆。我信。
不过，杨云帆的手机是最老旧的诺基亚，100来块钱一个，可没有微信功能。
看杨云帆迟迟不动，陆檀香还以为他不愿意，讪讪的又把手机放回去了。
这会儿，陆檀香看了一眼杨云帆身上洗得有点发白的T恤，又看了一眼杨云帆的旅行包，里面塞得鼓鼓的，好像什么都有。她不由道：“杨云帆，你是不是专业的驴友啊？我看你晒得这么黑，又懂那么多，一定是常年在外旅游玩。”
又有什么好玩的？
全世界哪个地方，不就吃喝玩乐四样吗？有那时间，我还不如多多修炼武功，把老头子给打趴下呢。
杨云帆哼哼了两声，没有多做解释。
谁知道，陆檀香看杨云帆不说话，还以为他默认了，顿时来了兴趣，七嘴八舌的问杨云帆都去过哪里。有没有去过布达拉宫？有没有去过草原骑马？有没有去过西沙群岛……巴拉巴拉的，还自顾自说什么巴厘岛那边的海景特别好看……

After all this trouble, the beautiful woman finally realized that the young man sitting next to her was not a stinky hooligan, but a warm-hearted person. At this time, in order to thank Yang Yunfan for his help just now, he invited him to drink Coke.
"There's no need to say thank you. But if you treat me to a Coke, you have some conscience."
Yang Yunfan took the Coke from the beautiful woman's hand, opened it with a "sneak", and couldn't help but drink it.
The beautiful woman was sweating just now, and the perfume on her body evaporated with the sweat, making the whole place full of fragrance. When she moved, the fragrance lingered. Yang Yunfan, a vigorous young man, smelled it and couldn't help but look at her a few more times.
On Ruyue's shy and pretty face, there were a few strands of wet and sticky green hair, which looked slightly messy, but made her even more charming.
"By the way, what's your name? You don't look like you're from Xiangtan City."
Anyway, I was bored and the train still had to take seven or eight hours, so Yang Yunfan casually chatted with the beautiful woman next to him.
The beautiful lady pursed her red lips slightly, drank some boiled water to moisten her throat, and said directly, "That's right. I'm not from Xiangtan, I'm from Donghai City. During the summer vacation, I played around in Shushan Mountain in the west. School is about to start, so I took the train back to Xiangtan City to go to school. Time flies so fast, and there are still many places I haven't visited yet."
The beautiful lady sighed, summer vacation passed too quickly.
Immediately, she looked at Yang Yunfan, smiled softly, stretched out her little hand, and said friendly: "My name is Lu Tanxiang, nice to meet you."
"Sanxiang? This name is quite interesting. The person who named you is probably an old Chinese medicine doctor." Yang Yunfan gave the beautiful woman in front of him a strange look.
Sandalwood has pungent taste, warm nature and non-toxic. Enters the spleen, stomach and lung meridians. Regulate qi and harmonize the stomach. It can cure abdominal pain, choking, diaphragm vomiting, and chest and diaphragm discomfort. "Compendium of Materia Medica" says that sandalwood can cure choking, diarrhoea, and vomiting. If there are sunspots on the face, wash them with water every night to make them red, grind the juice and apply them on the skin, and it can be cured.
"Hey, how did you know?"
Hearing what Yang Yunfan said, Lu Tanxiang was very surprised: "My grandfather gave me this name. He is really an old Chinese medicine doctor. He has been a Chinese medicine doctor for fifty years! Can he not be an old Chinese medicine doctor?"
Here’s the first question, which university are you from? Are you studying medicine? Also, you just said that I don’t look like a Xiangtan person, so are you a Xiangtan local? Ha, when you get to Xiangtan, you have to entertain me well. "
Yang Yunfan responded casually, but did not dare to agree.
Although his father bought a lot of properties in Xiangtan City before, he is not from Xiangtan City. His hometown is Donghai City.
Moreover, when he was very young, the old man took him to the mountains to live a hard life.
This time he gave the old man a hard blow. He didn't even have time to get the private money hidden behind the hut. Now his pockets are bare and it's almost a problem to feed himself... As for entertaining this beautiful woman, forget it.
And what the old man said about the beautiful CEO’s fiancée.
What a rip-off, the old man’s words can never be trusted. If he wants to be the fiancée of a beautiful CEO, she must be extremely ugly.
Master, why is my life so miserable?
Yang Yunfan looked sad, but Lu Tanxiang didn't know the reason.
She saw that Yang Yunfan was about the same age as her, carrying a travel bag, with a tanned face, a strong figure, and a sunny look. In addition, she had just pinched herself a few times, which cured her dysmenorrhea, so she became curious about Yang Yunfan.
"By the way, little brother, what's your name? "Lu Tanxiang blinked her eyes with an innocent look on her face.Looking at Yang Yunfan.
"My name is Yang Yunfan." Yang Yunfan said concisely and concisely.
"Yes, Yang Yunfan. I believe it.
However, Yang Yunfan’s mobile phone is the oldest Nokia, which costs about 100 yuan, but does not have WeChat function.
Seeing that Yang Yunfan was still moving, Lu Tanxiang thought that he was unwilling, so he put the phone back again.
At this moment, Lu Tanxiang glanced at Yang Yunfan's washed-out T-shirt, which was a little white, and then at Yang Yunfan's travel bag. It was bulging with stuff, as if it had everything. She couldn't help but said: "Yang Yunfan, are you a professional traveler? I see that you are so tanned and know so much. You must have been traveling abroad all year round. "
What else is fun?
Isn't there any place in the world where there are just four things to eat, drink and have fun? If I have that time, I might as well practice more martial arts and beat the old man to the ground.
Yang Yunfan hummed twice without further explanation.
Who knows, when Lu Tanxiang saw that Yang Yunfan was silent, she thought he had acquiesced. He suddenly became interested and asked Yang Yunfan where he had been. Have you ever been to Potala Palace? Have you ever been to the prairie for horse riding? Have you ever been to the Paracel Islands... Bala Bala Bala, and he said to himself that the sea view over Bali is particularly beautiful...
